INPUT IMAGE 1 IS THE STYLE REFERENCE. Reimagine this illustration as the scene described below, copying its bold inked cartoon drawing style very closely. Change the environment to the named biome, not its visual style. This is one complete background for the same cute creature game.
CRITICAL STYLE CORRECTION: thick BLACK / near-black ink outlines, clearly visible around foreground and middle-distance shapes. Use smooth rounded confident contours about 8–12 px wide on a 1536 px canvas, heavier for the closest large forms. The linework must be a conspicuous part of the drawing, as in the attached reference. Outline rocks, tree trunks, large foliage clumps, architecture, ice and clouds as appropriate. Use a small number of big simple rounded shapes and 2–3 flat color tones per material. Large clean cel-shaded regions, very sparse interior marks. Distant scenery is made of simple muted silhouettes like the reference.
AVOID fine-lined anime landscapes, painterly concept art, realistic textures, brushstrokes, tiny repeated foliage, intricate rock facets, elaborate lighting, glow bloom, glitter, granular detail. Do not merely add outlines to a detailed painted scene: simplify the whole drawing to match the reference. Use the scene's own colors; only the drawing style comes from Autumn Woods.
COMPOSITION: square 1536×1536 target, opaque and full bleed. Leave a broad calm unobstructed lower-center standing area, x28–72%, y75–100%; creature feet will be at x50%, y93%. No creature is drawn. Side scenery frames the view, lower central body area stays quiet. Ground runs through the bottom edge. Keep scene cues in the middle/lower half because the game crops from center-bottom. For pure space/void scenes, quiet dark emptiness can replace ground.
Simple distinct scenery masses suitable for subtle animation later. One static illustration, no layer sheet. No text, border, watermark, UI, people or featured creatures.

source.name: Colossal Whirlpool

Use three or four broad clean curling white-and-blue water bands spiraling toward a distant dark center in the middle background. Storm-blue horizon, side sea stacks. Wide stable slate ledge at bottom, no falling into vortex at feet.
